description: Shell library for running an HTTP server in tests, including setup, configuration, and test utility functions.

methods.name: install_script
methods.description: Writes a script to the HTTPD root directory from a template.

methods.name: prepare_httpd
methods.description: Sets up the HTTP server environment, copies configuration and scripts, and prepares SSL if enabled.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the HTTP server with the prepared configuration.

methods.name: enable_http2
methods.description: Enables HTTP/2 support in the server configuration.

methods.name: enable_cgipassauth
methods.description: Enables CGIPassAuth if the server version supports it.

methods.name: setup_askpass_helper
methods.description: Sets up a helper script for providing credentials during tests.

methods.name: set_askpass
methods.description: Configures the askpass helper with username and password.

methods.name: expect_askpass
methods.description: Verifies the askpass prompt output matches expectations.

methods.name: strip_access_log
methods.description: Processes access log entries to a simplified format.

methods.name: check_access_log
methods.description: Compares processed access log entries against expected entries.
